address: Pasaje de la Reta, Mendoza, M5549, Argentina
bio: It is, perhaps, a little surprising to find two brothers and wine experts Héctor and Pablo Durigutti at the helm, both of whom had the clear idea of focusing their efforts on fine dining as the perfect complement to their unique microcosmos at Finca Victoria, a family-run winery with two charming guest houses. The restaurant itself, located just a few metres from the winery’s HQ and totally surrounded by vineyards, occupies an elegant glass cube with a thatched roof and takes its name from the different types of soil found on the property. They offer several menus: Criollo (3 courses), Albedrío (7 courses), the so-called “5 Suelos” and another, more exclusive, called “Historia” (14 courses). The latter also features an astute wine pairing that explores the evolution of wine from Antiquity ...
